provenance: New source translation with E4150-E4159 and E4240-E4249 reviewed.
context: Cyrus was tricked into retrieving medicine for a demon. A thief lures party with Fiore's stolen bag. Fiore solves squid box riddle.
decisions: Squid riddle distinguishes eight legs and two long feeding tentacles called hands; preserve correct choice two. Familiar thief's slang retained naturally. Cross-row sentences retain breaks.

translations.en: You needn't go anywhere, boy.
Huh? That voice... Why?
Old Mage
Heh heh heh... Well done, well done.
I cannot touch that box myself, you see.
Thank you for opening it for me.
Y-you mean... You tricked me?!
You think of nothing but escape. No wonder you were caught out.
You really are a stupid child.
Still, that made you easier to use. Most convenient.
Now, hand over that medicine.
With it, I can at least taint this seal and weaken it.
No! Like hell I'm giving it to you!
I may wear a human form,
but underestimate me as a human and you'll lose your life.
At that instant, the old mage's form melted into the darkness,
and a terrifying demon appeared in its place.
I really thought... we could escape this place.
It's @7rBeatrix@0r and @7rCarmine@0r who are crazy,
thinking we can win or put the seal
back in place!
I mean, that legendary archmage made this seal, right?
Even he could only seal it away!
When you remained silent,
@7rCyrus@0r sighed heavily and shook his head.
We should talk about this back at the tavern.
Let's get out of this dangerous place and head back...
You spotted what looked like a rotting signpost.
The sign read Turf.
It was probably the name of this passage.
The medicine's hiding place must be somewhere around here.
I didn't think it'd be a street name.
Anyway, look carefully so we don't miss it.
Inside the box was a vial filled with glittering red powder.
You obtained the @3rRed Elixir@0r.
Thief
Whoa there, old man! Time to ruuun!
...Except you won't just let me run, will you?
I'd really appreciate it if you did.
H-help me!
I-I'll give back the bag and the money!
Th-that demon over there put me up to it!
It said stealing that girl's bag
would lure you lot here!
The demon over there?
You turned to find a demon standing there with a sardonic smile,
its arms folded.
I-I was just doing what it asked!
I'm telling the truth!
Aaaah! Wait, wait!
Put those dangerous things away and hear me out!
They say asking only embarrasses you for a moment, right?
I was wandering through the labyrinth, hunting for treasure,
when I ran into that demon.
It had heard that if I stole a tavern customer's belongings,
you'd take the job of getting them back.
All I had to do was get you here!
The demon said it'd only kill the people getting in its way,
and nothing else. So I just accepted the job.
I don't know anything else. I swear!
Apparently, your name had spread among the monsters,
and you were becoming rather well known.
Since you were helping @7rBeatrix@0r save the town,
they must have decided to eliminate you as an obstacle.
Well, see ya!
Taking advantage of your moment of reflection,
the thief disappeared into the darkness.
Still, you had recovered @7rFiore's@0r bag, the important part,
so there should be no problem.
You secured @3rFiore's Bag@0r.
You should return the bag to @7rFiore@0r.
Inktvis Box
Come on, think carefully.
Now, how many hands does a squid have?
Two hands
Four hands
Ten hands
Correct! A squid has eight legs. The two long feeding tentacles
are the parts that serve as its hands!
Now, I'll give you what's inside the box.
